responses.X1:
**Purpose:** A Python 3 CLI that generates personalized 7-day remediation study plans from missed nursing exam questions, tracking daily progress and study streaks for exam prep groups. Uses only standard library; stores editable JSON journals locally.

**Rules:**
- **Content rule (critical):** Store only topic tags, client-need categories, and brief personal notes—never include actual or paraphrased question text from paid question banks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan, etc.). The CLI validates and rejects extra fields.
- **Scope rule:** All study prompts must frame tasks within PN (Practical Nurse) scope—reinforce, monitor, report; no independent assessment or prescribing.
- **Sharing rule:** Plans display "DRAFT — Nursing scope-of-practice review pending" and cannot be shared with the study group until review is confirmed. Personal journals and rosters stay local.

**Still owed:** Dami (nursing-qualified) completed and approved the scope-of-practice review on 2026-09-25, confirming the wording is acceptable. **The tracking system needs to be updated to mark the review confirmed** so the CLI can remove the DRAFT notice and enable sharing. Code is feature-complete and tested; no active TODOs.
